sections.text_helper: Section 21.6.19 "ADC analog watchdog 2 configuration register (ADC_AWD2CR)" in chapter 21 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 658.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:14 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 13:0 AWDCH[13:0]: Analog watchdog 2 channel selection
These bits are set and cleared by software. They enable and select the input channels to be guarded
by the analog watchdog 2.
AWDCH[i] = 0: ADC analog input channel i is not monitored by AWD2
AWDCH[i] = 1: ADC analog input channel i is monitored by AWD2
When AWDCH[13:0] = 000..0, the analog Watchdog 2 is disabled
Note: The channels selected by AWDCH must be also selected in the SQi or JSQi bits.
Note: The software is allowed to write these bits only when ADSTART=0 and JADSTART=0 (which
ensures that no conversion is ongoing).
Note: Some channels are not connected physically and must not be selected for the analog
watchdog.
